user.title: Connect your AlphaESS battery
user.description: Enter the system serial printed on your battery or shown in the AlphaESS app. This integration receives existing traffic through a static router redirect; it does not scan or query the battery. The cloud destination is configured automatically. Listening settings are available under advanced options.

data.fallback_enabled: Use local reporting when the cloud is unavailable
data.inverter_rating_w: Inverter rating in W (only needed until learned from the device)

error.invalid_serial: Enter a valid battery system serial.
error.invalid_listener: Enter a valid IPv4 listening address and a port from 1024 to 65535.
error.listener_in_use: Another AlphaESS Relay entry uses this listening address and port. Open advanced listening settings to choose a different port.

init.title: Relay settings
init.description: Local fallback keeps receiving reports during cloud outages. The relay reconnects periodically to check cloud recovery. It does not upload locally acknowledged reports to the cloud. Changing settings restarts this connection; update your router redirect if you change the listening address or port.

data.fallback_enabled: Use local reporting when the cloud is unavailable
data.inverter_rating_w: Inverter rating in W (only needed until learned from the device)

error.invalid_listener: Enter a valid IPv4 listening address and a port from 1024 to 65535.
error.listener_in_use: Another AlphaESS Relay entry uses this listening address and port.

cannot_listen.message: The relay listening port is unavailable. Free the port or change it in the integration options.
